title: PubMed pilots a visual map of connected biomedical research
friendlyTitle: PubMed has a new way to explore related medical research
summary: Linked Discoveries is an early-stage NLM pilot that builds neighborhoods around PubMed articles, surfacing related papers, shared genes, chemicals and conditions, plus citations, funding, reviews and retractions.
friendlySummary: Linked Discoveries shows papers connected to a PubMed article and adds useful details such as shared topics, funding, reviews and retractions.
whyItMatters: Researchers and curious readers can explore the evidence around a paper instead of reading it in isolation. The pilot may make contradictory findings, retractions and less prominent related work easier to spot.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help you understand the wider evidence around one study and notice important papers you might otherwise miss.
